title: Nice Jazz Festival tribute to Louis Armstrong
summary: She appeared at Newport and Nice with the band; the unveiling of Louis's bust in Nice.

blocks.x: The next thing you did, though, was a performance -- at least, the next recorded thing you did was a performance at the Nice Jazz Festival. I think it's the Grande Parade du Jazz.
Do you want to talk about that?

Yeah. I had appeared on two previous Newport Jazz Festival programs. One in Providence quite before the Newport Jazz Festival moved to New York. And, of course, I was on a bill that the first Newport Jazz Festival in New York on that section in which Benny Carter appeared, and Teddy Wilson accompanied me on that. So, I would think that maybe as a result of that, I got an invitation to go to the jazz festival

Nice.

And, of course, this was at the time when they unveiled the bust of Louis Armstrong.

And, of course, the Newport Jazz Festival is another one of those festivals where they have lots of musicians, and you never know who you're going to wind up singing with, nor what's going to come out on an album if and when they release one.

So, I appeared on the segment at the concert with The World's Greatest Jazz Band. And one of the selections I did was 'You're Driving Me Crazy,' with Bob Wilber on soprano sax; Ralph Sutton on piano, and Bob Haggard on bass.

So I see that they've released that -- that part of the Newport Jazz Festival album.
And it's not issued in this country as far as I know it. It's on the French RCA label.

That was part of a tribute to Louis Armstrong, I think you were saying.

Well, that was the year that they unveiled the bust of Louis in Nice. And Lucille was there, and Princess Grace Kelly and most of the French royalty. But that was quite a festival. I haven't been over there since, but that was my first experience. And it was something else again. I had never been to France before. I don't know whether I'll get there again, but I enjoyed that. I see that they've included my rendition of 'You're Driving Me Crazy' in that album that they put out.
